sessions.text:
User: I'm cleaning up logging across our services. In general, when a service runs in dev, I go with ERROR-level logging.
Assistant: Understood: ERROR-level logging for services in dev. Which service should we start with?
User: The invoice-sync worker. It's also slow on startup, any idea why?
Assistant: Slow startup is usually eager imports or connection pool warm-up. Want me to look at the logging first?
User: Yes, logging first. I'll send the config tomorrow.
Assistant: Sounds good, I'll wait for the config.

User: New service today: shipping-notify.
Assistant: Okay. Anything about how you want it configured?
User: Standardize on DEBUG-level logging for every service.
Assistant: Got it: DEBUG-level logging for every service.
User: Last thing: make every log format string pipe-separated with the timestamp first.
